# `docs/` — what lives where

<!-- Generated by `theagent2 init` from docs/.structure.yaml — edit the yaml, not this file. -->

This is the spec of this project's design-artifact tree (ADR-030 §4, staged by the
Diamond Process, ADR-040). The machine-readable original is `docs/.structure.yaml`;
`theagent2 init` creates every directory below (each with a `.gitkeep`) and re-renders
this page. To add a directory, add it to the yaml and re-run `theagent2 init`.

## The tree

```
docs/
  00_Design-Book/
  01_Planning/
  02_Business/
    01_Business-Processes/
    02_System-Interactions/
    03_Sequence-Map/
    05_Business-Map/
    06_Screen-Models/
  03_Technology/
    01_System-Design/
    02_Call-Chains/
    02_Spec/
    03_Validation/
    04_Resources/
  04_Gates/
```

## What belongs in each

| Directory | What belongs there |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/00_Design-Book/` | The generated Design Book (ADR-052) — the front door onto everything below. |
| `docs/01_Planning/` | Transcripts, interview notes and the charter — what the stakeholders actually said. |
| `docs/02_Business/` | The business design — what the system does, in the stakeholders' terms. |
| `docs/02_Business/01_Business-Processes/` | One `BP##_<Name>.md` per business process, with the BPMN diagrams behind it. |
| `docs/02_Business/02_System-Interactions/` | The use cases — `SIxx.yy_<Name>` markdown and activity diagrams, filed under their BP. |
| `docs/02_Business/03_Sequence-Map/` | The sequence map — one row per use case, read at the Blueprint gate. |
| `docs/02_Business/05_Business-Map/` | The business map — the consolidated view of processes, actors and their artifacts. |
| `docs/02_Business/06_Screen-Models/` | The screen models the mockup and the scaffolder both read. |
| `docs/03_Technology/` | The system design — how the system is built. |
| `docs/03_Technology/01_System-Design/` | Components, their contracts, and the decomposition diagrams. |
| `docs/03_Technology/02_Call-Chains/` | Call chains `CCxx.yy` and sequences `SQxx.yy.zz`, grouped by facet. |
| `docs/03_Technology/02_Spec/` | The component specifications (ADR-033) settled at the Contract gate. |
| `docs/03_Technology/03_Validation/` | Validation reports and sequence-diagram reviews. |
| `docs/03_Technology/04_Resources/` | One protocol sheet per resource seam (ADR-065). |
| `docs/04_Gates/` | The gate dossiers (ADR-051) — one directory per gate, named for the gate. |

Ids — `BP##`, `SIxx.yy`, `CCxx.yy`, `SQxx.yy.zz` — and the filenames that carry them are
the `design-artifact-conventions` skill's business, not this page's.
